description: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 water risk indicators, July 2023 release, HydroBASINS level 6, joined to EPA GHGRP facility coordinates by point in polygon.
provenance_note: The water indicators are a WRI hydrological model, not a company disclosure. The facility coordinates they are joined to come from mandatory EPA GHGRP filings. No self-reported figure is used.
licence: CC BY 4.0. Cite: Kuzma, S., M.F.P. Bierkens, S. Lakshman, T. Luo, L. Saccoccia, E. H. Sutanudjaja, and R. Van Beek. 2023. 'Aqueduct 4.0: Updated decision-relevant global water risk indicators.' Technical Note. Washington, DC: World Resources Institute. doi.org/10.46830/writn.23.00061
redistribution: CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution of derived tables and charts with attribution to the World Resources Institute and a link to the licence.
attribution_required: World Resources Institute, Aqueduct 4.0 (2023), CC BY 4.0
layer_choice_reason: The only GDB layer whose geometry is the basin x province x aquifer union that string_id keys. baseline_monthly and future_annual are basin only.
future_scenario: bau business as usual, SSP3 RCP7.0

indicator_codebook.bws: Baseline water stress: withdrawals as a share of available renewable surface and groundwater supply. Extremely High is >80%.
indicator_codebook.bwd: Baseline water depletion: the share of available water consumed, not merely withdrawn. Extremely High is >75%.
indicator_codebook.iav: Interannual variability: year to year variation in water supply.
indicator_codebook.sev: Seasonal variability: within-year variation in water supply.
indicator_codebook.gtd: Groundwater table decline: rate of decline of the water table in cm per year. Extremely High is >8 cm/y.
indicator_codebook.rfr: Riverine flood risk: expected annual share of population affected by river flooding.
indicator_codebook.cfr: Coastal flood risk: expected annual share of population affected by coastal flooding.
indicator_codebook.drr: Drought risk: composite of drought hazard, exposure and vulnerability, 0 to 1.
indicator_codebook.ucw: Untreated connected wastewater: share of collected wastewater that is not treated.
indicator_codebook.cep: Coastal eutrophication potential: nutrient loading delivered to coastal waters.
indicator_codebook.udw: Unimproved or no drinking water: share of population without improved drinking water.
indicator_codebook.usa: Unimproved or no sanitation: share of population without improved sanitation.
indicator_codebook.rri: Peak RepRisk country ESG risk index.
indicator_codebook.w_awr_def_tot: Weighted aggregated water risk, default weighting, overall. A 0 to 5 composite of the 13 indicators.

suffixes._score: indicator mapped to a 0 to 5 scale
suffixes._cat: integer category -1 to 4 (-1 and -9999 are special, see notes)
suffixes._label: human readable category with its threshold

category_traps.bws_cat = -1: Arid and Low Water Use. bws_score is 5.0, the maximum, but the label is not 'Extremely High'. Counted separately here, never folded into the high stress share.
category_traps.gtd_cat = -9999: Insignificant Trend, which is a real finding and not missing data. 60,244 of 68,510 basin rows. gtd_score is also -9999 there, so it must be masked before any mean.
